Maya (CSM): Hey team — kicking off the activation for Calyx Health Systems. They signed yesterday and want an internal demo in 2 weeks. Need to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a pragmatic first-30d timeline. Proposed kickoff: Wed 10:00am PT. Quick context: PHI-sensitive, require SSO (SAML), KMS integration, and demo latency target ~<300ms for short prompts.

Priya (Account Exec): Thanks Maya — contract is fully executed. Renewal risk looks low but they flagged compliance docs + SOC2 reporting as blockers for legal signoff. I'll surface the legal checklist during kickoff.

Ethan (Success Eng): I can own the technical runbook. Immediate asks we should confirm before kickoff: VPC peering or VPN (which they prefer), KMS key policy, and if they want Redwood Private vs Dedicated for initial pilot. Estimate: smoke test within 5 business days after access.

Maya (CSM): High-level stakeholders (please confirm):
- Jules (Calyx PM) — customer PM, primary day-to-day contact
- Dr. Rivera (Calyx Data Lead) — model/quality owner (attending demos)
- Priya (Account Exec) — contract/renewal owner
- Ethan (Success Eng) — tech lead from Redwood
- Maya (CSM) — onboarding project lead

Success criteria (candidate list):
1) Demo flow: secure SSO + demo conversation under 300ms 75% of the time
2) Data control: KMS in place and documented access pattern
3) Integration: Prefix/KV caching working with their expected clinical prompt patterns
4) Enablement: 2 internal power-users trained and a runbook for failover

Ethan (Success Eng): Adding a minimal initial checklist (will flesh out in Confluence):
```
- Confirm network path (VPC peering / VPN)
- Provision service account and RBAC
- Configure KMS + verify key rotation policy
- Deploy demo model (quantized variant) to dedicated pool
- Run perf smoke tests: 50 requests, measure p50/p95
```

Jules (Calyx PM): Wed at 10am PT is fine for our core team but Dr. Rivera asked if we could do 11am PT instead to accommodate clinic times. Either works though. Also curious who runs the enablement session for power-users.

Maya (CSM): 11am PT works for Redwood too. Updated proposed time to Wed 11:00am PT. @Priya — can you confirm Dr. Rivera will join?

Priya (Account Exec): Confirmed — Dr. Rivera and Jules will be there. I'll bring the contract/SLAs and legal notes. Also will collect the SOC2 artifact list pre-meeting.

onboard-bot: task CALYX-001 created: "Initial access and network checklist" assigned to Ethan, due 5 business days after kickoff. :white_check_mark:

Ethan (Success Eng): Thanks. I'll start network pre-checks once Jules shares the VPC ranges. Can someone add the demo prompt set to the shared Drive? I'd like to simulate their clinical flows.

Jules (Calyx PM): Uploading prompt set now to the shared folder. Link: https://drive.redwood.example/calyx/prompts (internal).

Maya (CSM): Great — summary and owners:
- Kickoff: Wed 11:00am PT (calendar invite sent) — Maya/Priya/Ethan/Jules/Dr. Rivera
- Network & KMS: Ethan (owner) — CALYX-001
- Legal/SOC2 artifacts: Priya (owner)
- Demo prompt + perf targets: Jules + Ethan
- Enablement session for power-users: Maya to schedule, Priya to lead contract topics

Risks: data-compliance gating demo; if KMS/SSO delayed the demo will shift and that could increase friction toward renewal. Flagging for Exec attention if access not provisioned by Day 7.

Priya (Account Exec): I'll escalate to legal now and ask for SOC2 checklist by EOD Monday.

Maya (CSM): Perfect. Thanks everyone — I'll post the detailed agenda and meeting notes after kickoff. :party:
